notes: Implemented Phase 2 of expander icon and positions plan: Mobile FAB. Replaced toolbar hamburger button with a floating action button (FAB) at bottom-right of viewport for toggling the mobile bottom sheet. Followed TDD Red-Green-Refactor cycle: wrote 30 unit tests (DOM structure, CSS styles, icon logic, method regression) and 12 E2E tests (visibility, toggle behavior, ARIA attributes, keyboard operability, rapid toggle, regression). All 42 new tests pass, plus all 1400+ existing tests across 51 test files pass with 0 regressions. World-review identified 6 concerns: (1) z-index occlusion — already correct (FAB 200 > bottom sheet 160), (2) viewport-fit=cover — already set, (3) rapid toggle guard — already exists in $nextTick callback, (4) FAB styling — already has border-radius:50%, box-shadow, proper colors, (5) aria-haspopup — added as progressive enhancement, (6) bottom sheet padding — correctly accounts for FAB overlap. No learnings worth documenting — all patterns (FAB positioning, safe area insets, z-index stacking, DOMParser parentElement verification) are standard practices already covered in existing skills.
